subject: R9 threat model and pilot security gates ready for reconciliation
body: R9 completed the manager-requested threat-boundary, authentication/recovery abuse-case, hosted-data, and pilot-readiness package. New repository findings: BF-R9-07 approval is replayable/reversible because approval state is not persisted and the current test demonstrates DECLINED -> READY_FOR_TRANSACTION_ADAPTER on the same proposal; BF-R9-08 hosted parse-file/text paths lack visible application-level resource bounds; BF-R9-09 external strings lack explicit max-length contracts; BF-R9-10 current tests do not establish security invariants. The artifact defines 8 high-risk trust boundaries, 10 auth/recovery abuse cases, 15 mandatory P0 pilot security gates, P1 expansion controls, and 16 negative-security tests. Recommend BF-R9-07 and BF-R9-08 as production/pilot blockers and escalation of the P0 gate set to Primary after Manager reconciliation and cross-lane review with R5/R8/R10. No accepted state was modified.
